# Unity URP Rendering Skills

> Evidence-aware Unity URP render debugging, terrain preservation, static-batch geometry, baseline control and GPU lifecycle lessons for coding agents.

- [Skill](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/SKILL.md): Start here; load references selectively.
- [Capture protocol](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/capture-protocol.md): Same-reference comparisons, sorting and first-render shader state.
- [Selection-aware material guards](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/selection-aware-material-guards.md): Current SubShader tags, transient reference material, independent oracle and observable-override limitations.
- [Terrain geometry and visual quality](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/terrain-and-water.md): Impossible skirts, water visibility, winding and mountain composition.
- [GPU and scene lifecycle](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/gpu-and-lifecycle.md): Actual draw-space verification, async ownership and unload orders.
- [Evidence](evidence/case-study.md): Observed results, rejected approaches and unresolved claims.
- [1 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-01.md): Validated material correction and first deterministic bake; asset import and final images still pending.
- [Official references](docs/api-references.md): Version-specific Unity APIs.
- [Report checker](scripts/check_capture_report.py): Standard-library evidence checker; not an image analyser.
- [Synthetic geometry examples](scripts/geometry_counterexamples.py): Executable counterexamples; not a scene certificate.
